title: I Shall Live as a Prince
altTitles: I Shall Live As A Prince
description: Lee Hyun Ho, an ordinary job seeker from modern Korea, is suddenly reincarnated as Grand Prince Jinseong of the Joseon Dynasty. Unfortunately, his new older brother is Yeonsangun, a notoriously tyrannical king. Determined to survive and protect his future family, Hyun Ho uses his knowledge of history to change the fate of Joseon and turn his brother into a better ruler.
author: Dopamine
